review_evidence.c7_real_tool_closure: Real debug compared the old failed adapter output against the successful Phase4 evidence. Complete Maestro sidecars and +escchars/+preset flags were not sufficient when the run package flattened the netlist bundle into the run root: OCEAN saw plain names and slash formulas returned nil. Running Spectre from a directory literally named netlist with sibling psf restored slash names and made rise/fall/DC match Phase4. Code now prepares rendered input at runs/real/<run_id>/netlist/input.scs, copies exported sidecars under that netlist directory, runs Spectre from it, and keeps PSF at runs/real/<run_id>/psf. Verification: python3 -m pytest -q passed 445 tests; python3 -m ruff check . passed; real adapter plus Hermes check-real-run/check-metric-results/record-real-result passed for /tmp/ic_auto_opt_c7_fixed_001/bridge_test_inv.
